text:
chris_sales: Heads-up — FinTrust wants a 3-week POC combining BYO-HSM + Redwood Dedicated. Need preflight: HSM lead time, proposed cost split, and security questionnaire answers. Proposed kickoff Mon Apr 12. Who can own the infra preflight? cc @laura_eng @vikram_security

laura_eng: I can drive POC infra. Quick clarifier — do they want the HSM inside their VPC (peered) or an on-prem connector? Network/runbook implications differ and affect lead time.

chris_sales: They said 'HSM in our VPC, customer-supplied KMIP endpoint' — so peering + customer-managed keys. Also they asked if we can guarantee key rotation within 30 days as a contractual item. Is that realistic?

vikram_security: Rotation within 30 days is fine from a capability standpoint. We need to document: 1) we do not export private keys, 2) rotation is customer-initiated via KMIP or our APIs, 3) we have an automated rekey job option. Will also add SOC2/PCI language for the SQA.

anya_se: I'll draft the SQA responses. Suggested wording: 'Redwood supports customer-managed keys via external KMS/HSM with non-exportable keys; integration via KMIP or CloudHSM-compatible APIs. Key material is never exported by Redwood.' Good?

laura_eng: That's accurate. Add: 'Redwood supports key wrapping/unwrapping operations with HSM-backed key handles; RW service caches prefixes and KV entries — cache invalidation occurs on rotation.' Also ops note: schedule a 10–15m maintenance window during rekey to ensure cache flush and KV warmup.

chris_sales: Pricing question from procurement: they want a 50/50 cost split for the POC (Dedicated capacity vs HSM rental). Can we propose: POC discount 30% off Dedicated hourly, HSM rental at cost, and a setup SOW fee? What number for SOW?

laura_eng: For presales I can approve a reduced SOW. Suggest $3,000 for setup (networking, peering, runbook, short training). Dedicated discount for POC OK — we should run exact cost model. Quick estimate: 2x A10G equivalent, reserved for the 3 weeks, with autoscale off. I'll produce calc by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: SOW template v3 uploaded to presales bucket: https://redwood.s3/poctemplates/sow-v3.pdf :thumbsup:

vikram_security: For the SQA section on rotation, propose this snippet: 'Customer-managed keys: Redwood supports rotation initiated by the customer via KMIP. Recommended rotation frequency is configurable. Redwood enforces atomic rollout with a recommended 10-minute maintenance window to ensure KV cache invalidation and to avoid serving mixed-key responses.'

anya_se: I'll incorporate that and send a draft to Chris for customer review. Also confirming HSM appliance provisioning lead time is typically 7-10 business days for cloud HSM or vendor appliance; if they need on-prem hardware procurement add another 5–7 days.

laura_eng: Network/runbook + quick connectivity check (example):
```
# sample kmip client test
kmip-tool --host kmip.fintrust.local --port 5696 --test-connectivity
# expected: AUTH OK, TLS handshake success
```

chris_sales: Plan agreed: Laura owns infra & cost calc; Anya will send SQA answers; Vikram finalizes rotation language; I'll propose start Mon Apr 12 contingent on HSM provisioning by Apr 5. If we hit provisioning delays we'll push start or arrange a small windowed pilot on hosted only. Thanks all :pray:
